main_measure.name: pooled excess forward 5-bar return after forecast <= -10 (vs holding baseline)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if negative with t <= -2; reject if positive with t >= +2; at least 30 cases

supporting_check.name: number of coins with negative mean excess return

decided_by: The pooled t lies strictly between -2 and +2, meeting the inconclusive rule.
reading: The holding baseline is the mean forward 5-bar return over all bars of each coin and window (not only grid bars), extreme cases are grid bars at positions 0,5,10,... with forecast <= -10, and 'at least 2 of the 3 coins' is applied literally as at least 2 coins negative, which with only BTC and ETH in the record means both.
